scenarios.expected: Each account sees only its permitted records/actions, including the Administrator exception. Removed membership/Grants cease granting access; parent or related-record links do not grant inherited reach.
scenarios.actual: Nadia opened C-76 and M-21 with no team entry and was refused C-77, M-22, and the Confidential Entity with Something went wrong. and Reload, which did not grant access; a missing number read the same way; search listed the shared records and omitted both Confidential children. A team entry added by Daniel admitted her to C-77 and M-22 with the Confidential switch and Add team member disabled, and removing it refused the next read. Owner and Matter Manager assignment admitted her without a team entry, and returning them to Daniel refused her again. Adding and removing her on the non-Confidential records kept her ordinary access. Manage access granted her the Entity, which then opened without a Manage access control, and removal refused it. C-76 and M-21 showed Restricted contract and Restricted Matter without a title or link, including the Confidential Contract linked to M-21. A Confidential baseline Document on C-76 and on M-21 was omitted for her and returned after the mark was cleared. Her comments panel offered three tiers and showed the Legal only comment.

scenarios.expected: Each account sees only its permitted records/actions, including the Administrator exception. Removed membership/Grants cease granting access; parent or related-record links do not grant inherited reach.
scenarios.actual: Daniel opened all four records and the Confidential Entity without a Grant. Through the Team applet and the Matter team he added and removed Nadia and Ravi; the Owner and Matter Manager comboboxes reassigned Nadia and restored himself, with each state confirmed after a reload. Manage access granted and removed Nadia's Grant while his own access stayed. Actions for the baseline Documents marked and cleared the Confidential mark. He posted Legal only comments, saw the titled child links and the linked C-77, and his search listed the Confidential child. The final check found the fixture teams, accountable people, no Grants, the C-77 link, and the baseline Documents restored.

limitations: Independent agent walkthrough by a different agent from the author; not a human user study and not the feature owner's approval.

compatibilityReview.summary: The recorded historical walkthroughs retain their actual app/build identities. The only runtime changes in these ranges are the comment merge, empty Entity-calendar query normalization, and archived Knowledge Document read described below. The changed procedures already have independent walkthroughs on builds containing those fixes. No historical walkthrough is claimed to have been replayed at the target.
